tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000260dam pa rigs brgya'i lha dbang gi bkol byang bzhugs so// 1$0000300hūm̐/ chos rnams rnam dag ye nas lhun gyis grub// bya ba byed dang yid chos rnam par dag /nam mkha'i mtha' bzhin kun la snyoms mdzad pa// kun bzang yab yum gnyis kyis dbang bskur ro// hūm̐ a a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pas dbang bskur ro// hūm̐ oṃ swā āṃḥhā a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ ngo mtshar pho brang bde bar gshegs pa'i yum// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad skyed mdzad ma// rigs kyi yum gyur rnams kyis dbang bskur ro// mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ rnam shes dbang po dag pas sku gsung thugs// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi sras mchog ste// sems dpa' chen po brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro// ma hā satwa a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar can// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i mchod pas rgyal ba mchod// byang chub lha mo'i tshogs kyis dbang bskur ro// bo dhi de wī a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ bdug spos me tog mar me dri chab ma// rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams la mchod 'bul ma// mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dbang bskur ro// pū dza de wi' a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ drag shul thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa// tshad med bzhi ldan sgo bzhi thub par bsrung*// ta kṛta sgo ba bzhi yis dbang bskur ro// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ rtag chad mthar phyin gsang ba yum gyi ngang*// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'khrol ma// sgo ma chen mo bzhi yis dbang bskur ro// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ steng 'og phyogs bzhi 'jig rten 'dul mdzad gtso// nyon mongs drug 'joms rgyud drug dag par sbyong*// bcom ldan thub pa drug gis dbang bskur ro// sarba mu ni a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/

hūm̐/ 'jigs byed 'das pa'i dus na mngon byung ba// gdug pa 'dul phyir dus las mi 'da' ba'i// dpal chen he ru ka rnams kyis dbang bskur ro// sarba shrī he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ khro mo dbang phyug sku la 'khril mdzad cing*// mkha' 'gro mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ma// gdug pa 'dul mdzad yum gyis dbang bskur ro// sarba kro dhī shwa rī a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// ye shes sku mchog 'jigs byed rgyan gyis brgyan/ khro mo chen mo brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro// ha a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing*// 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che// phra men chen mo brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro// he a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gdong mo pho nya mgyogs ma bzhi// shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi thub par srung*// sgo skyong khro mo bzhi yis dbang bskur ro// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ hūm̐/ dpal gyi 'khor tshogs badzra ā ralli// mkha' la shugs 'gro ma tshogs dbang phyug ma// rnal 'byor nyi shu brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro// bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/

shin tu bsdu na/ mi rtog rdo rje thabs kyi ye shes ni// dmigs med shes rab yum gyi ngang du rtogs// thugs rje'i bye brag sna tshogs cir yang ston// zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal bas dbang bskur ro// zhes dang*/ rtsa sngags sam/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes dbang bskur bas/ 'di ltar chos thams cad dam pa rigs brgya'i ngo bor dag cing*/ de yang rang sems lhag pa bden gnyis dbyer med gsang chen rigs gcig tu rnam par dag pa yin no// zhes rtogs pa bskyed do/// /
